name: 天鹅座 · Hα 广域
note: Finkbeiner v1.1 WHAM/VTSS/SHASSA via NASA LAMBDA, HEALPix Nside1024 nested Galactic. Linear Rayleigh map, no extinction correction. Nominal source FWHM 6′ (WHAM-only areas may be coarser); nearest native-pixel sampling onto 0.1° TAN plane, not a new high-resolution measurement or flux-conservative reprojection. Negative/nonfinite values, invalid errors and SATUR/BRT_OBJ flags masked. Native errors and removed-star/interpolation flags remain in source cache. Hα includes diffuse Galactic emission: do not add another Galactic Hα template. ESO local airglow/pollution/moon added once under the existing assumed sky model. No star synthesis; OIII absent.

lines.note: Observed Hα survey; Rayleigh to energy conversion. OIII is missing, not zero measured flux.
